The story

WHY

Kim thought she knew the people around her. She had plans, ambitions and a future she believed she could control.

Dr Ade was a man whose life revolved around his career. But some encounters have a way of changing things we never expected to change.

Behind familiar faces lie untold stories and unspoken conversations. Hidden meanings and secret decisions that cannot be easily reversed.

As the story unfolds, questions emerge, secrets linger and the truth becomes harder to ignore.

What really happened? Who knew what? And why did everything happen the way it did?
